description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). The page file is written by hand. Its to_block is the literal 9007199254740993, beyond 2^53 - 1. An unsafe integer makes the page structurally invalid, so every escrow is unverified, although the page holds a finalized release for a1.
